results.name: interests
results.sql: CREATE TABLE interests (   request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,   payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,   city TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (city IN ('Зеленоградск', 'Калининград', 'Светлогорск')),   items_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(items_json)),   desired_date TEXT NOT NULL,   delivery TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (delivery IN ('pickup', 'delivery', 'undecided')),   price_consent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_consent = 1),   value_total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (value_total >= 0),   created_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

results.name: submission_tokens
results.sql: CREATE TABLE submission_tokens (   request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,   rate_key TEXT NOT NULL,   window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,   slot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (slot BETWEEN 1 AND 6),   expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,   UNIQUE (rate_key, window_start, slot) )

results.name: interest_preferences
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE interest_preferences (
  request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES interests(request_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  occasion TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (occasion IN ('undecided','dinner','apartments','picnic','company','gift')),
  preferred_time TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (preferred_time IN ('undecided','morning','day','evening')),
  partner_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (partner_type IN ('none','apartments','bakery'))
)
